name: Do I need to replace the entire window, or just the glass, if it's foggy?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to replace the entire window, or just the glass, if it's foggy?

acceptedAnswer.text: Often, you only need to replace the glass unit (the insulated glass unit or IGU) and not the entire window frame. If your window frame is in good condition – not rotting, warped, or otherwise damaged – replacing just the glass is a more cost-effective solution. This process involves carefully removing the old, foggy glass and installing a new IGU into the existing frame. A professional can assess your specific situation to determine the best approach.
acceptedAnswer.description: In many cases, only the foggy glass unit needs replacement, not the entire window, if the frame is in good condition.
